json.answer: Data will be generated at each of our institutional sites. The PI at each institution will be responsible

section.title: for following the data management guidelines described below, and for saving the data to the RIC
section.description: servers. This process of transferring all data to a central location will be facilitated by our research

question.text: project coordinator. Our data management guidelines will be reviewed at the kickoff meeting for the

section.title: Types of data
section.description: The Data Management Plan should describe the types of data, samples, physical

question.text: collections, software, curriculum materials, or other materials to be produced in the course

json.answer: of the project. It should then describe the expected types of data to be retained and shared,

question.text: and the plans for doing so. The DMP should cover how data are to be managed and

section.title: We will manage all scientific and technical content generated from this proposal. Our products will

question.text: First, we will have data related to each of our proposed experiments. These will include the detailed

json.answer: protocols used for each experiment, the raw data collected from each experiment, and the

question.text: experimental code used to collect those data. The relevant code will include both the data acquisition

json.answer: code, and the code for the controllers used in the experiment. Together, this information will be

section.title: sufficient for recreating the circumstances of each data collection session.
section.description: Our second type of data will be the code and results for all analyses completed on experimental data.

question.text: Specifically, we store all code necessary to recreate figures, tables, and other results reported in all

json.answer: published manuscripts.

question.text: The proposed foundational developments will produce substantial simulation code for controller

section.title: development and testing. These and the outputs relevant to all key findings will also be managed.
section.description: Policies for access and sharing and appropriate protection and privacy

question.text: The Data Management Plan should describe the period of time the data will be retained

json.answer: and shared; factors that limit the ability to manage and share data, e.g., legal and ethical

question.text: restrictions on access to human subjects data; and provisions for appropriate protection of

json.answer: privacy, confidentiality, security, and intellectual property.

section.title: Data will be made available upon request, after the conclusion of each of study. The availability of
section.description: data (raw and analyzed) will be advertised on the project’s website. Access will be free, but the

question.text: original data collector/creator/principal investigator retains the right to use the data for analysis

json.answer: before making it publicly available. No patient identifying information will be included in any of the

question.text: available data files.

json.answer: Select videos of the experiments will be distributed, with subject faces blurred so as to be

section.title: unidentifiable. Experimental analyses results will be made available through peer-reviewed journal
section.description: publications and conference presentations. The code needed to generate all published results will be

question.text: documented clearly.

json.answer: Software generated under the project will be released under the GNU Public License, and available

question.text: for free download on the labs’ websites. This includes code for each of our 3 experimental systems.

json.answer: We commit to speaking with any qualified scientist who wishes to discuss our results or the

section.title: technology employed to obtain our results.
section.description: There will be no copyright or licensing required for any of the data generated in this project.

question.text: Research records will be archived for a minimum of seven years after final reporting or publication

json.answer: of a project. If any questions regarding the research, including but not limited to research integrity

question.text: allegations, are raised during the seven- year retention period, the PI will keep the records until such

json.answer: questions are fully resolved.

section.title: Data storage and preservation of access
section.description: The Data Management Plan should describe the mechanisms and formats for storing data

question.text: and making them accessible to others, which may include third party facilities and

json.answer: repositories; and other types of information that would be maintained and shared regarding

question.text: data, e.g. the means by which it was generated, detailed analytical and procedural

json.answer: information required to reproduce experimental results, and other metadata.

section.title: The servers at the Rehabilitation Institute of Chicago will serve as the central repository for all
section.description: collected data. Raw data files will be saved in either Matlab or comma-separated value (CSV)

question.text: format. Code for converting between these formats will also be provided to ensure easy access. The

json.answer: contents of each data file, including the experimental conditions or the analysis procedures used

question.text: during generation will be documented. All raw data will be de-identified to ensure subject

json.answer: anonynimity.

section.title: Upon request, data will be made available through the project's website, hosted on an archived server
section.description: run by the RIC IT Team.
